serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I met one weird guy and he told me how to invest on the stock market through an internet service. Since then I can make a living like that.
Big Daddy: Oh, wow. I always thought that these websites are sketchy at best.
You: Risk is big, but if you invest carefully and wisely like me, you can make a lot of money quickly.
Big Daddy: That’s very impressive, but be careful. One market crash and you could go broke.
You: Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing.
